15827-the-great-round-world-and-what-is-.title: The Great Round World And What Is Going On In It Vol 1 No 34
15827-the-great-round-world-and-what-is-.creator: Unknown
15827-the-great-round-world-and-what-is-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Fitted with an achromatic lens of superior quality, having a set of three stops; has two finders, one for vertical and one for horizontal exposures; and is also provided with two sockets for tripod screws, one for vertical and one for horizontal exposures. Fitted with improved rotary shutter, for snap-shots or time exposures. Can be loaded in daylight.

arxiv-2201-04304.title: Quantum Dynamics of Cold Atomic Gas with S ​ U ​ ( 1 , 1 ) SU(1,1) Symmetry
arxiv-2201-04304.creator: Jing Zhang, Xiaoyi Yang, Chenwei Lv, Shengli Ma, Ren Zhang
arxiv-2201-04304.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jing Zhang, Xiaoyi Yang, Chenwei Lv, Shengli Ma, Ren Zhang. Motivated by recent advances in quantum dynamics, we investigate the dynamics of the system with S ​ U ​ ( 1 , 1 ) SU(1,1) symmetry. Instead of performing the time-ordered integral for the evolution operator of the time-dependent Hamiltonian, we show that the time evolution operator can be expressed as an S ​ U ​ ( 1 , 1 ) SU(1,1) group element.

arxiv-2206-10669.title: Stabilizing and improving qubit coherence by engineering noise spectrum of two-level systems
arxiv-2206-10669.creator: Xinyuan You, Ziwen Huang, Ugur Alyanak, Alexander Romanenko, Anna Grassellino, Shaojiang Zhu
arxiv-2206-10669.description: Abstract Superconducting circuits are a leading platform for quantum computing. However, their coherence times are still limited and exhibit temporal fluctuations. Those phenomena are often attributed to the coupling between qubits and material defects that can be well described as an ensemble of two-level systems (TLSs).

arxiv-2305-13860.title: Jailbreaking ChatGPT via Prompt Engineering: An Empirical Study
arxiv-2305-13860.creator: Yi Liu 1 , Gelei Deng 1 , Zhengzi Xu 1 , Yuekang Li 2 , Yaowen Zheng 1 , Ying Zhang 3 , Lida Zhao 1 , Kailong Wang 4 , Tianwei Zhang 1 , Yang Liu 1
arxiv-2305-13860.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yi Liu 1 , Gelei Deng 1 , Zhengzi Xu 1 , Yuekang Li 2 , Yaowen Zheng 1 , Ying Zhang 3 , Lida Zhao 1 , Kailong Wang 4 , Tianwei Zhang 1 , Yang Liu 1. Large Language Models (LLMs), like ChatGPT , have demonstrated vast potential but also introduce challenges related to content constraints and potential misuse.

arxiv-2408-09331.title: Numerical Computation of High Reynolds Number Cavity Flow Using SPH Method with Stream Function and Vorticity Formulation
arxiv-2408-09331.creator: Yusuke Imoto
arxiv-2408-09331.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yusuke Imoto. When numerically computing high Reynolds number cavity flow, it is known that by formulating the Navier-Stokes equations using the stream function and vorticity as unknown functions, it is possible to reproduce finer flow structures. Although numerical computations applying methods such as the finite difference method are well known, to the best of our knowledge, there are no examples of applying particle-based methods like the SPH method to this problem.

arxiv-2505-10139.title: Path Gradients after Flow Matching
arxiv-2505-10139.creator: Lorenz Vaitl, Leon Klein
arxiv-2505-10139.description: Abstract Boltzmann Generators have emerged as a promising machine learning tool for generating samples from equilibrium distributions of molecular systems using Normalizing Flows and importance weighting. Recently, Flow Matching has helped speed up Continuous Normalizing Flows (CNFs), scale them to more complex molecular systems, and minimize the length of the flow integration trajectories.

arxiv-2505-13668.title: MAFA: A Multi-Agent Framework for Annotation
arxiv-2505-13668.creator: Mahmood Hegazy, Aaron Rodrigues, Azzam Naeem
arxiv-2505-13668.description: Abstract Modern consumer banking applications require accurate and efficient retrieval of information in response to user queries. Mapping user utterances to the most relevant Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) is a crucial component of these systems. Traditional approaches often rely on a single model or technique, which may not capture the nuances of diverse user inquiries.

arxiv-2509-04710.title: Network-Aware Differential Privacy
arxiv-2509-04710.creator: Zhou Li, Yu Zheng, Tianhao Wang, Sang-Woo Jun
arxiv-2509-04710.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhou Li, Yu Zheng, Tianhao Wang, Sang-Woo Jun. Differential privacy (DP) is a privacy-enhancement technology (PET) that receives prominent attention from the academia, industry, and government. One main development over the past decade has been the decentralization of DP, including local DP and shuffle DP.

arxiv-2512-01991.title: Neural steering vectors reveal dose and exposure-dependent impacts of human-AI relationships
arxiv-2512-01991.creator: Hannah Rose Kirk, Henry Davidson, Ed Saunders, Lennart Luettgau, Bertie Vidgen, Scott A. Hale, Christopher Summerfield
arxiv-2512-01991.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hannah Rose Kirk, Henry Davidson, Ed Saunders, Lennart Luettgau, Bertie Vidgen, Scott A. Hale, Christopher Summerfield. Humans are increasingly forming parasocial relationships with AI systems, and modern AI shows an increasing tendency to display social and relationship-seeking behaviour. However, the psychological consequences of this trend are unknown. Here, we combined longitudinal randomised controlled trials ( N = 3,532 N=3{,}532 ) with a neural steering vector approach to precisely manipulate human exposure to relationship-seeking AI models over time.

arxiv-2601-12923.title: On Kippenhahn curves of low rank partial isometries Note: The results are partially based on the Capstone project of [NP] (2023-24 academic year) under the supervision of [IMS]. The latter was also supported in part by Faculty Research funding from the Division of Science and Mathematics, New York U
arxiv-2601-12923.creator: Nikita Popov, Eric Shen, Ilya M. Spitkovsky
arxiv-2601-12923.description: Abstract Conditions are established for rank three partial isometries to have circular components contained in their Kippenhahn curves. In particular, such matrices with circular numerical ranges are described. It is also established that the Gau-Wang-Wu conjecture holds for matrices under consideration. 1 Introduction Let A be a bounded linear operator acting on a Hilbert space \mathcal{H} .

arxiv-2603-29040.title: Stability of Ginzburg-Landau pulses via Fredholm determinants of Birman-Schwinger operators
arxiv-2603-29040.creator: Erika Gallo, John Zweck, Yuri Latushkin

plos-pone-0001775.creator: Jérémy Bluteau, Sabine Coquillart, Yohan Payan et al.
plos-pone-0001775.description: PLOS ONE research article. Learning to perform new movements is usually achieved by following visual demonstrations. Haptic guidance by a force feedback device is a recent and original technology which provides additional proprioceptive cues during visuo-motor learning tasks. The effects of two types of ha

pmc-10737779.title: HETEROGENEITY OF PREFRONTAL CORTICAL ACTIVITY DURING WALKING AMONG OLDER ADULTS
pmc-10737779.creator: Emma Baillargeon, Theodore Huppert, Caterina Rosano, Andrea Rosso
pmc-10737779.description: Higher prefrontal cortical (PFC) activity during simple walking may indicate neural compensation for impaired gait automaticity. On average, older adults have higher PFC activity during walking than younger adults, but the heterogeneity amongst older adults is understudied. We examined PFC activity during simple and dual-task walking in adults aged 65+ (n=173, mean age=72, 62% female).

pmc-11321553.title: Leprosy and lymphatic filariasis-related disability and psychosocial burden in northern Mozambique
pmc-11321553.creator: Robin van Wijk, Litos Raimundo, Domingos Nicala, Yuki Stakteas, Adelaide Cumbane, Humberto Muquingue, Julie Cliff, Wim van Brakel, Artur Manuel Muloliwa, jong-Yil Chai, Lynne Elson, jong-Yil Chai, Lynne Elson, jong-Yil Chai, Lynne Elson
pmc-11321553.description: IntroductionLeprosy and lymphatic filariasis (LF) are among the most disabling neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) that affect the citizens of Mozambique, especially in the Northern provinces. The irreversible impairments caused by these NTDs often lead to psychosocial consequences, including poor mental wellbeing, stigma and reduced social participation.

pmc-11409312.title: Arterial stiffness after 6 weeks postdelivery in women with a history of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy: a systematic review protocol
pmc-11409312.creator: Xolani Mbongozi, Stuart Galloway, Angus Hunter, Charles Bitamazire Businge
pmc-11409312.description: AbstractIntroductionHypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) are one of the leading causes of maternal morbidity and mortality. The risk of developing cardiovascular diseases following HDP is high. Arterial stiffness is a prognostic indicator for cardiovascular disease in the general population, and it is elevated during pregnancy in women with HDP.

pmc-11416860.title: Functional genomic analysis of genes important for Candida albicans fitness in diverse environmental conditions
pmc-11416860.creator: Emily H. Xiong, Xiang Zhang, Huijuan Yan, Henry N. Ward, Zhen-Yuan Lin, Cassandra J. Wong, Ci Fu, Anne-Claude Gingras, Suzanne M. Noble, Nicole Robbins, Chad L. Myers, Leah E. Cowen
pmc-11416860.description: SUMMARYFungal pathogens such as Candida albicans pose a significant threat to human health with limited treatment options available. One strategy to expand the therapeutic target space is to identify genes important for pathogen growth in host-relevant environments. Here, we leverage a pooled functional genomic screening strategy to identify genes important for fitness of C. albicans in diverse conditions.

pmc-11433601.title: Characterization of Thermal Expansion Coefficient of 3D Printing Polymeric Materials Using Fiber Bragg Grating Sensors
pmc-11433601.creator: Constantina Matsika-Klossa, Nikoleta Chatzidai, Charoula Kousiatza, Dimitrios Karalekas, Jun Liu, Patricia Krawczak
pmc-11433601.description: This work aims at the determination of the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) of parts manufactured through the Fused Deposition Modeling process, employing fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensors. Pure thermoplastic and composite specimens were built using different commercially available filament materials, including acrylonitrile butadiene styrene, polylactic acid, polyamide, polyether-block-amide (PEBA) and chopped carbon fiber-reinforced polyamide (CF-PA) composite.

pmc-11516399.title: Child-targeted foods in the Portuguese market 2024: Nutritional characteristics and claims
pmc-11516399.creator: R Brazão, P Fernandes, A Lopes, M G Dias
pmc-11516399.description: BackgroundExcessive consumption of high-energy products with high saturated fats, sugars, and salt contents, contribute to the prevalence of overweight, obesity and other related diseases in Portugal, especially among children. Children represent a vulnerable group whose food choices are significantly influenced by advertisements and marketing methods that often promote highly palatable and less healthy foods.

pmc-12384986.title: Towards an Implantable Aptamer Biosensor for Monitoring in Inflammatory Bowel Disease
pmc-12384986.creator: Yanan Huang, Wenlu Duan, Fei Deng, Wenxian Tang, Sophie C Payne, Tianruo Guo, Ewa M Goldys, Nigel H Lovell, Mohit N Shivdasani
pmc-12384986.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a relapsing–remitting condition resulting in chronic inflammation of the gastrointestinal tract. Present methods are either inadequate or not viable for continuous tracking of disease progression in individuals. In this study, we present the development towards an implantable biosensor for detecting interleukin-6 (IL-6), an important cytokine implicated in IBD.

pmc-12463508.title: Neonatal Sepsis Caused by Human Parechovirus Type A3 With Marked Hyperferritinemia: A Case Report
pmc-12463508.creator: Fumihiro Ochi, Mao Niida, Ayumi Sawada, Kozo Nagai, Hitomi Hino, Koji Takemoto, Hisamichi Tauchi
pmc-12463508.description: Background: In neonates and young infants, human parechovirus A3 (PeV-A3) is associated with severe infections, such as sepsis and encephalomyelitis. However, the mechanisms behind severe illness and the proper indications and methods for treatment remain ambiguous. Case Report: A previously healthy 25-day-old female was admitted to our hospital with a history of high-grade fever, a growling voice, and poor feeding.

pmc-12473905.title: A Modified Triaxial Electrospinning for a High Drug Encapsulation Efficiency of Curcumin in Ethylcellulose
pmc-12473905.creator: Xingjian Yang, Qiling Wang, Zhirun Zhu, Yi Lu, Hui Liu, Deng-Guang Yu, Sim-Wan Annie Bligh
pmc-12473905.description: Background: Although electrohydrodynamic atomization (EHDA) consistently provides drug-encapsulation efficiencies (DEE) far above those of conventional bottom-up nanotechnologies, the question of how to systematically push that efficiency even higher remains largely unexplored. Methods: This study introduces a modified triaxial electrospinning protocol tailored to the application and benchmarks it against two conventional techniques: single-fluid blending and coaxial electrospinning.

pmc-12521646.title: Molecular landscape of the fungal plasma membrane and implications for antifungal action
pmc-12521646.creator: Jennifer Jiang, Mikhail V Keniya, Anusha Puri, Xueying Zhan, Jeff Cheng, Huan Wang, Gigi Lin, Yun-Kyung Lee, Nora Jaber, Caifeng Zhao, Cynthia Pang, Yasmine Hassoun, Haiyan Zheng, Erika Shor, Zheng Shi, Sang-Hyuk Lee, Min Xu, David S Perlin, Wei Dai
pmc-12521646.description: Fungal plasma membrane proteins represent key therapeutic targets for antifungal agents, yet their native structure and spatial distribution remain poorly characterized. Herein, we employ an integrative approach to investigate the organization of plasma membrane protein complexes in Candida glabrata, focusing on two abundant and essential membrane proteins, the β-(1,3)-glucan synthase (GS) and the proton pump Pma1.

pmc-12594970.title: Hybrid glowworm swarm optimization with recurrent deep learning for fault detection in industrial internet of things environment
pmc-12594970.creator: G Anitha, Hariprasath Manoharan, Abirami Manoharan
pmc-12594970.description: Fault detection (FD) has been important in Industry 4.0 to reduce the cost of manufacturing in the contemporary industry. FD was widely used to determine the health of the medical equipment. Online FD method has been critical in identifying faults in industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) equipment.

pmc-12610676.title: Improved Detection of Minimal Residual Disease in AML: Validation of IDH1/2 ddPCR Assays in the Perspective of Treatment with Target Inhibitors
pmc-12610676.creator: Katsiaryna Nikitsenka, Giacomo Danieli, Lucia Tombolan, Barbara Mancini, Davide Facchinelli, Giorgia Scotton, Alberto Tosetto, Omar Perbellini, Daniela Zuccarello, Elisabetta Novella
pmc-12610676.description: Mutations in IDH1/2 are frequent in Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML), defining a molecularly distinct subgroup with therapeutic implications due to the availability of specific inhibitors. Accurate monitoring of treatment response is crucial and Droplet Digital PCR (ddPCR) offers a sensitive approach for quantifying mutational burden in IDH-mutated AML.

pmc-12651341.title: Comparative Evaluation of [68Ga]Ga-Fibroblast Activation Protein Inhibitor vs. [18F]FDG as a Novel Radiotracer for Biology-Guided Image Radiotherapy
pmc-12651341.creator: Lin Qiu, Yue Chen, Trevor Ketcherside, Zhixing Wang, Todd DeWees, Terence M Williams, Arya Amini, Sagus Sampath, Scott Glaser, Yi-Jen Chen, Liu Lin, David Leung, An Liu, Heather M McGee, Avraham Eisbruch
pmc-12651341.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryBiology-guided radiotherapy (BgRT) uses PET radiotracer emissions as image guidance to deliver adaptive targeted radiation to tumors. Due to limitations of the PET radiotracer 18F-Fluorodeoxyglucose ([18F]FDG), there is significant interest in developing alternative radiotracers for BgRT. Fibroblast activation protein (FAP) is a transmembrane protein that is overexpressed in cancer-associated fibroblasts within multiple tumor types with minimal expression in normal tissues. Fibroblast activation protein inhibitors (FAPIs) bind avidly to FAP and can be labeled with a radiotracer such as Gallium-68 (68Ga).

pmc-13063567.title: Zuclopenthixol inhibits residual activity of acid sphingomyelinase in Niemann pick disease type B: a case report with in vitro validation
pmc-13063567.creator: Maximilian Schiller, Katharina Marie Steiner, Udo Bonnet, Erich Gulbins, Norbert Scherbaum
pmc-13063567.description: Niemann-Pick disease type B (NPD-B) is a rare lysosomal storage disorder characterized by residual activity of acid sphingomyelinase (ASM). While functional inhibitors of ASM (FIASMAs) are widely prescribed as psychotropic medications, they may pose a particular risk to patients with NPD-B by further reducing the already impaired enzymatic function.

pmc-13272307.title: Diagnostic performance of plasma p-Tau217, p-Tau181, and p-Tau231 across the Alzheimer’s disease continuum: a network meta-analysis
pmc-13272307.creator: Xiaofen Chen, Tingting Huang, Chao Shi, Shuizhi Xu, Shuwei Fan
pmc-13272307.description: ImportanceBlood-based biomarkers (BBMs) are transforming the diagnostic workflow for Alzheimer’s disease (AD). However, there is no consensus on the optimal phosphorylated tau (p-tau) isoform (217, 181, or 231) or analytical platform [mass spectrometry (MS) vs. immunoassay (IA)] for clinical implementation across different disease stages.

pmc-13331635.title: Predictors of Relapse and Post‐Relapse Outcomes After Frontline Blinatumomab in Philadelphia Chromosome‐Negative B‐ALL
pmc-13331635.creator: Sankalp Arora, Hagop Kantarjian, Koji Sasaki, Nitin Jain, Zhouxuan Li, Wei Qiao, Sanam Loghavi, Guilin Tang, Caitlin Rausch, Farhad Ravandi, Fadi G Haddad, Jayastu Senapati, Guillermo Montalban Bravo, Alexandre Bazinet, Rita Khouri, Rebecca Garris, Guillermo Garcia‐Manero, Nicholas J Short, Elias Ja
pmc-13331635.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ultiagent chemotherapy regimens has improved outcomes in patients with newly diagnosed Philadelphia chromosome‐negative (Ph‐negative) CD19+ B‐cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B‐ALL) [1, 2, 3, 4]. In a phase 3 trial, the addition of blinatumomab to consolidation chemotherapy in patients who achieved flow cytometry‐based measurable residual disease (MRD) negative remission demonstrated a significantly improved 3‐year overall survival (OS) and 3‐year relapse free survival (RFS) of 85% and 80%, respectively [5].

pmc-13387850.title: Post-Acute Sequelae of COVID-19 Across 15 Major Health Domains and 67 Diseases in Individuals With Depressive Disorder: A Korean Nationwide Cohort Study
pmc-13387850.creator: Jaehyeong Cho, Selin Woo, Jaeyu Park, Yejun Son, Hyesu Jo, Hayeon Lee, Ho Geol Woo, Hanseul Cho, Guillaume Fond, Laurent Boyer, Yerin Hwang, Dong Keon Yon
pmc-13387850.description: BackgroundIndividuals with depressive disorder often face barriers in accessing healthcare; however, research on the acute and post-acute sequelae of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) (PASC) in this population remains limited. We aimed to investigate the risk of PASC in individuals with depressive disorder.

pmc-13479605.title: How Functional Variants Reconfigure the Rac2 Conformational Landscape
pmc-13479605.creator: Nurit Haspel, Hyunbum Jang, Ruth Nussinov

pmc-13634734.title: A computational workflow for proteome-wide analysis of sulfur-containing amino acid distribution in crop proteomes
pmc-13634734.creator: Husam Jamal Omari, Maher Jamal Tadros
pmc-13634734.description: Grain legumes are important sources of plant protein for human food and animal feed, but their nutritional quality is often limited by relatively low levels of sulfur-containing amino acids, particularly methionine. Despite their biological and nutritional importance, the distribution of methionine and cysteine across reference proteomes and within protein sequences remains insufficiently characterized.
